task_title: Containment disclosure feature flag and discovery markers
task_criteria: Flag off preserves byte-identical probe output and omits BUNKER_SANDBOX; flag on appends one greppable containment marker to strict allowlisted system probes without changing exit codes, leaves non-probe commands untouched, injects BUNKER_SANDBOX=1, honors BUNKERD_CONTAINMENT_DISCLOSURE over config, includes table-driven tests and docs, and live bunker-mvp verification records flag-on marker plus clean flag-off output and VERIFY-PASS.

items.criterion: Flag off preserves byte-identical probe output and omits BUNKER_SANDBOX; flag on appends one greppable containment marker to strict allowlisted system probes without changing exit codes, leaves non-probe commands untouched, injects BUNKER_SANDBOX=1, honors BUNKERD_CONTAINMENT_DISCLOSURE over config, includes table-driven tests and docs, and live bunker-mvp verification records flag-on marker plus clean flag-off output and VERIFY-PASS.
items.detail: Code/tests/docs sub-requirements are met: `go build ./...` exit 0; `go test ./internal/server/... ./internal/config/... ./internal/agent/... -count=1 -timeout 180s` => `ok github.com/deployBunker/bunker/internal/server 1.447s`, `ok .../internal/config 0.011s`, `ok .../internal/agent 7.875s` (exit 0). Byte-identical flag-off is pinned by exact-string tests (disclosure_test.go:273-380), marker emission by markerFrameForStream (disclosure.go:270-283) sent after wg.Wait() before the exit-code frame (service.go:432-441), exit-code preservation by TestContainmentMarkerPreservesNonZeroExit (disclosure_test.go:243), strict allowlist by probeSafeFlags/isContainmentProbe (disclosure.go:44-200), BUNKER_SANDBOX=1 via config.ContainmentSandboxEnv (config.go:44) injected in all builders, and BUNKERD_CONTAINMENT_DISCLOSURE via SetEnvPrefix("BUNKERD")+BindEnv("containment.disclosure") (config.go:238-240,284) with env-beats-file tests (config_test.go:218-248). Table-driven tests and docs (README.md:146-166, specs/containment-disclosure.md, config.example.yaml:61-71) exist. HOWEVER the criterion's final clause — 'live bunker-mvp verification records flag-on marker plus clean flag-off output and VERIFY-PASS' — is NOT satisfied: no committed verification artifact exists. `grep -n 'containment|BUNKER_SANDBOX|VERIFY-PASS' e2e-full-battery.sh` returns nothing (exit 1); commit 96dc43f contains no verify/e2e/dogfood/log artifact (git show --name-only | grep -i 'verify|e2e|dogfood|log|evidence' => exit 1); there is no GAP-067 entry in .gitreins/history and no docs/dogfood GAP-067 record. The task's own board entry (.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl) explicitly requires 'Live E2E on bunker-mvp: flag on → spawn → exec uname -a shows marker; flag off → clean. VERIFY-PASS evidence committed.' — that evidence is absent.
